{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm QA orders are missing
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Preprocess revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the first few cleaned values
df[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head()"}
